title: Create interface to get dissector value_strings indirectly
description: Create a lookup table for modules outside of epan to access value_strings (and value_string_ext) so that epan can be more independent.

notes.body:
The long-term goal is to have epan as a "standalone" library and to be able to build Wireshark without dissector code.  It's more about enforcing better encapsulation within epan/UI than a desire to build a dissector-less Wireshark.
One of the major list of link errors if you remove the dissector code is the value_strings from dissectors used by dissector specific UI and tap code.  I wanted to see if this was a direction worth pursuing before doing the grunt work to convert all the current value_strings used in UI/taps to this new abstraction.

added 1 commit
  • 8ca943da - Create interface to get dissector value_strings indirectly
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20688/diffs?diff_id=1438995262&start_sha=30cceeafac4442dcb8ba73c61a3a1133499fa7d0)

I think this could be a useful direction, also something similar with true_false_strings. Would a possible goal be to have the value_string interface in libwsutil instead? There might be use cases for using value strings in libwiretap, for example.

Another issue is that Windows [doesn't really let you import and export data](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18529#note_2274428134), as opposed to functions, so some kind of encapsulation would make it possible to use common value_strings and true_false_strings in plugin dissectors, which works fine on UN*X but doesn't work on Windows.

I'm (slowly) working towards having value_string be in libwsutil.  The big hangup is the use of wmem_packet_scope() in val_to_str.  Once we can get rid of that, I think it will fit nicely in libwsutil.

I don't know about the name.. I would preferred to remove the first `vs_` and just have `register_external_value_string`. Other functions are named like `register_srt_table`, `register_dissector` etc.
I'm certainly not tied to the name, removing the prefix is fine with me.

commits_data.message:
Create interface to get dissector value_strings indirectly

Create a lookup table for modules outside of epan to access value_strings (and value_string_ext) so that epan can be more independent.

Needed to modify asn2wrs.py functionality to generate the value_string registration for those that needed it.
